1.explanation: Notification.js contains the ActionableNotification implementation and needs to be updated to actually render the caption prop in the component’s markup. Notification-test.js should be extended to include a test asserting that the caption appears when provided. The ActionableNotification story file should include an example of caption usage (or be updated to demonstrate the fixed behavior). These three files cover the implementation, verification, and documentation examples for the missing caption feature.
1.bug_scenario: The ActionableNotification component advertises a “caption” prop in its documentation and propTypes (showing under the Playground tab), but when a user passes caption="Caption not working." nothing renders. Screenshots show the docs listing caption as a string prop, the sample JSX passing caption, and the propTypes block in Notification.js declaring caption — yet the rendered notification never displays the caption text.

2.explanation: In Notification.js, the ActionableNotification function destructures props but never reads or renders the caption value. That is the core of the bug. Notification-test.js currently does not include any test asserting that a caption string appears, so it needs to be updated to cover the new behavior. Finally, the Storybook story in ActionableNotification.stories.js shows the playground and should be updated (or verified) to render the caption prop so users can visually confirm it works in the docs.
2.bug_scenario: When a consumer of the @carbon/react library supplies a caption prop to <ActionableNotification>, nothing is rendered. Although caption is declared in ActionableNotification.propTypes and documented in the playground, the implementation never extracts or outputs the caption, so the extra line of text (for example a timestamp) never appears under the subtitle.
